description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder, which handles percent-encoding operations such as encoding and normalizing URIs, with special handling for reserved characters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PercentEncoder
classes.description: A class for encoding and normalizing percent-encoded URIs, with configurable preservation of certain characters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with optional characters to preserve during encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string by percent-encoding all non-reserved characters and preserved characters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Decodes unreserved characters in a percent-encoded string and normalizes the encoding.
